name: inspect_region
description: Read the latest full state, candidates, and bounded context for one review region without modifying it. The initial task already includes ±3 context, so use this only when wider context or a refreshed state is genuinely needed.

before.description: Relations to include before the region.

after.description: Relations to include after the region.

name: accept_candidate
description: Apply one listed candidate's exact after result to the whole region. candidate_id must exactly match an ID in candidate_ids; an empty list means this tool is unavailable, and none/null must never be invented as an ID. A non-empty user-authored open_flags note requires a repair that addresses the stated issue; an unrelated or cosmetic change does not resolve it, and the unchanged candidate is removed. Defer instead if it cannot be resolved reliably. Otherwise accept only after checking complete semantic correspondence, information placement, completeness, and order. An unchanged original non-1:1 structure is also not approvable. Strategy is only a tie-break between correct results. Candidate origin is preserved and AI review is recorded separately.

candidate_id.description: Exact candidate ID from that region's candidate_ids. Never use none or null.

keep_flags.description: False normally: remove open [F] flags covered by this reliable decision. True only when substantial ambiguity, missing context or knowledge, or inability to resolve the issue still justifies later human review. Do not keep a flag merely because it already exists.

name: edit_region
description: Atomically replace one review region when no candidate is correct. Submit the complete final ordered bilingual units exactly once. Each unit is one naturally indivisible publishable block on both sides; preserve independent paragraphs or sentences as separate units. Its N source and M target entries are fragments to join within that same unit, not a container for packing independent blocks together. Use this to repair boundaries, restore missing information in its proper context, or make either side naturally readable in its language. When information belongs to an adjacent context relation, include the smallest necessary contiguous scope in relations and relocate it instead of copying it. Keep unrelated text stable and do not use missing placeholders.

relations.description: Optional ordered contiguous relation range to replace. Omit when editing only the review region. It may include adjacent context_relations when information must be relocated, but must include the complete review region and must not overlap another review region.

src.description: Ordered source fragments belonging to this one indivisible publishable unit.

tgt.description: Ordered target fragments belonging to this one indivisible publishable unit.

reason.description: Concise reason no supplied candidate was correct.

keep_flags.description: False normally: remove open [F] flags covered by this reliable edit. True only when substantial ambiguity, missing context or knowledge, or inability to resolve the issue still justifies later human review.

name: delete_region
description: Delete the entire review region when the strategy makes that side extraneous, such as target-only content under document-A-first, or when the region is a confirmed duplicate. This is a content decision, not a substitute for defer_region when evidence is uncertain.

reason.description: Concise reason the complete region should be removed.

keep_flags.description: False normally: remove open [F] flags covered by this reliable deletion. True only when substantial ambiguity or insufficient evidence still requires human review.

name: defer_region
description: Leave one region's content unchanged and send it to human review when the available evidence is insufficient for a reliable resolution.

reason.description: What remains ambiguous and what a person should verify.

name: finish_review
description: Optional compatibility tool. Runs finish automatically after every region is resolved; this call is only needed to request an explicit completion check.
